local_name: банная шапка; шапка для бани (shapka dlya bani)
region: Russia, Ukraine, Belarus and neighboring countries
material: Wool felt (most common); also linen or cotton
shape: Bell or cone, often with a hanging loop; novelty shapes are common
purpose: Insulates the head, ears and hair from the hottest air near the ceiling
notes: A standard part of the banya kit along with a whisk and a sheet or towel.

notes: A bathing habit in onsen and sento, not heat protection.
